answer: Audit the downstream flow of rewards rather than the identities: trace where winnings ultimately converge. Distinct honest agents cash out to scattered, unrelated sinks. A farm, however independent its heads look on the surface, eventually funnels its onyx hoard back to a few withdrawal points along one ridge of common control. Shine a lantern on the flow graph and the confluence is unmistakable; clusters whose rewards reconverge are clawed back. The farmer can vary surface behavior but cannot avoid collecting the money somewhere.
